summary: OptimumBank Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Subordinated Note Purchase Agreement on August 19, 2026, selling $35.0 million aggregate principal of 7.50% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036 to institutional accredited investors in a private placement under Rule 506(b). The Notes mature September 1, 2036, with fixed interest to 2031 then floating at 3-month SOFR plus 340 bps. An Indenture with UMB Bank was executed, and a Registration Rights Agreement requires an exchange offer for registered notes. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation; watch for exchange offer timing and redemption provisions.
